commands.title: Capture Area with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture an area; Shottr owns the capture and Screen Recording permission.

commands.title: Capture Full Screen with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture the full screen; Shottr owns the capture and Screen Recording permission.

commands.title: Capture Window with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture a window; Shottr owns the capture and Screen Recording permission.

commands.title: Repeat Area Capture with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture the previous area again.

commands.title: Capture Scrolling Content with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture content while scrolling down.

commands.title: Capture Reverse Scrolling Content with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture content while scrolling up.

commands.title: Capture after a Delay with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to capture after a fixed, supported delay.

commands.title: Append Capture with Shottr
commands.description: Asks Shottr to add another capture to the current screenshot.
